item: The sequential collect loop reads the next source's label through one helper, so a pool timeout on the reload cannot end the pass
summary: Found by the Opus read of #1439; it is the F4 listed as low risk, made concrete. At parallelism 1 every source shares the caller's session. When one source fails inside ingest the rollback expires every other Source object it holds, and the loop's progress line read source.domain outside any try: the same reload through a pooled connection that ended the pass in _process_source's handler, one line earlier in the loop. One helper (_source_label, falls back to ?) now serves that line and the handler. Red without: the first source rolls back and the next checkout made from run_scrape_once itself raises the pool timeout once; unfixed the pass raises, fixed three sources store and the pass reports 3 processed.
